_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_AHZShowEnemyHealthStatsInfo: Show's enemy health numbers on top of the health meter
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_AHZShowEnemyMagickaMeterInfo: Show's a magicka meter for enemies.  It will only show for enemies with magicka
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_AHZShowEnemyMagickaStatsInfo: Show's enemy magicka numbers on top of the magicka meter
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_AHZShowEnemyStaminaMeterInfo: Show's a stanima meter for enemies.  It will only show for enemies with stamina
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_AHZShowEnemyStaminaStatsInfo: Show's enemy stamina numbers on top of the stamina meter
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ActivationKey: If selected, The activation key toggles the widgets on and off.  Otherwise the activation key activates the widgets while being held down
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_DisplayDelayDescription: The time delay in milliseconds before the moreHUD widgets are displayed.  This is for users who do not want the widgets showing immediately when targeting an object.  Note: This option is not enabled if the Hotkey Only activation mode is selected
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_DisplayTargetWeight: Display target weight with carry weight
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_EnemiesFullyGreen: Enemies at or below the players level by this amount will indicate fully green.  The closer the enemy's level is to the player, the color will become closer to white.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_EnemiesFullyRed: Enemies at or above the players level by this amount will indicate fully red.  The closer the enemy's level is to the player, the color will become closer to white.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_IconSizeDescription: Sets the size of the icons like the book read icon or the enchantment known.  All icons will be set to this value
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_LoadInfoPU: Your settings will be downloaded from Data\SKSE\Plugins\moreHUD\[Specified name].json
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_LocationStatusDungeonsOnlyInfo: Only shows location status for destinations marked as dungeons.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_LocationStatusExteriorOnlyInfo: Only shows location status when entering an interior from an exterior worldspace, hiding doors between nested interior cells.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_LocationStatusHideUnvisitedInfo: Hides the unvisited label while still showing visited and cleared locations.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_PresetBadInfo{}: The preset is damaged or does not meet the requirements\n{}
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_PresetNameInfo: Name preset, which will be used to save the current settings
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SaveInfoPU: Your settings will be saved to Data\SKSE\Plugins\moreHUD\[Specified name].json
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsActivationMode: Sets the activation mode for the widgets:\nAuto-Always: Shows the widgets automatically when targeting an object,   Auto-No Combat: Shows the widgets automatically when targeting an object when the player is not in combat,   Hotkey Only: Only shows the widgets when toggled with the hotkey
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsAlignmentInventory: Sets alignment for the inventory's count widget: Left, Right, or Center
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsAlignmentPlayer: Sets alignment for the player's data widget: Left, Right, or Center
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsHotkey: Sets the hotkey used to activate the widgets
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsScaleBottom: Sets the Scale of the bottom widget, 25% - 200%
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsScaleIngredient: Sets the Scale of the ingredient widget, 25% - 200%
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsScaleInventory: Sets the Scale of the inventory's count widget, 25% - 200%
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsStyleEffects: Sets the style of the effects widget
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsStyleIngredient: Sets the style of the ingredient widget
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsXPositionBottom: Sets the X position of the bottom widget, 0% Left, 100% Right
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsXPositionIngredient: Sets the X position of the ingredient widget, 0% Left, 100% Right
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsXPositionInventory: Sets the X position of the Inventory count widget, 0% Left, 100% Right
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsYPositionBottom: Sets the y position of the bottom widget, 0% Top, 100% Bottom
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsYPositionIngredient: Sets the y position of the ingredient widget, 0% Top, 100% Bottom
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SetsYPositionInventory: Sets the y position of the Inventory count widget, 0% Top, 100% Bottom
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowLocationStatusInfo: Shows whether an interior location is unvisited, visited, or cleared.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowsArmor: If selected, shows the armor weight class for the targeted armor.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowsBottomBar: If selected, shows the bottom bar that shows player damage, armor rating, weight, and gold.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowsBottomBarAlways: Always shows the players information such as gold and weight even when not targeting an object.  This overrides any hot key toggling.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowsCurrentNumber: If selected, shows the current number of items in the player's inventory that match the targeted object. (Only when the player has more than one)
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowsEffectsEnchanted: If selected, shows the effects when targeting an object such as enchanted items, scrolls, spell tomes, potions, and food.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowsEnemysSoulLevel: If selected, shows the enemy's soul level (Non-sentient)
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowsEnemyslevel: If selected, shows the enemy's level when in combat with them.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowsIconBook: If selected, shows an icon indicating if a targeted book has been read.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowsIconDisenchanted: If selected, shows an icon when the player has already disenchanted the effect of the targeted weapon or armor.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowsIngredientEffects: If selected, shows the ingredient effects when targeting an object that can be harvested or an ingredient.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowsInventoryCountEventWhenZero: When enabled, the inventory count will show even when the player does not have any in their inventory
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowsSkill: If selected, shows the skill that a skill book teaches.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowsTargetsWeight: If selected, shows the target's weight + the player's weight.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_ShowsValue: If selected, shows the value to weight ratio next to the value and weight.
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_SureWantContinue: \n\nAre you sure you want to continue?
line:mcm_flick_translation/morehud:ahzmo.$mHUD_UnistallQuestion: Are you sure you want to remove the mod?
